================================================================================
Bare word
================================================================================
b
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Unsafe conflict elsewhere does not split a word in a word-valid state
================================================================================
ab
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Exact keyword followed by a separate word
================================================================================
a b
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Raw keyword retained alongside its conflict partner
================================================================================
b a
---
(program (word) (keyword))

================================================================================
Retained keyword preserves precedence over a longer competing token
:error
================================================================================
b a-
---
(program (word) (keyword) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Exact keyword works in a safe state where word is absent
================================================================================
!a b
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Safe keyword-only state cannot split a longer word
:error
================================================================================
!ab
---
(program (ERROR) (word))

================================================================================
Trailing word cannot be silently ignored
:error
================================================================================
!a b c
---
(program (keyword) (ERROR (word)) (word))
